ideas.idea: List all loaves on the breads page (or page per loaf)
ideas.why: The page claims over twenty loaves but names only two, so listing them gives readers and machines concrete text.

ideas.idea: Add class details (dates, price, group size, booking) as text
ideas.why: classes.html has no concrete details or booking route, which is accurate and helps users and machines understand the offering.

ideas.idea: Add address, opening hours and pre-order info, optionally with Bakery/LocalBusiness JSON-LD
ideas.why: No page gives address or hours for a local bakery, and the text-first advice is accurate and specific.

ideas.idea: Add Organization or WebSite structured data
ideas.why: Missing JSON-LD is explicitly not a required fix, and this is a boilerplate suggestion that adds little here.
Accurate that there are no dates, but lastmod is a minor, near-universal suggestion with little effect on a 3-URL site.

ideas.idea: Link between pages from the content (breads to classes or pre-order)
ideas.why: Content on breads and classes has no onward links, so contextual links would help readers and crawler discovery, though nav already links everything.
Accurate that og tags are missing, but this applies to nearly any site and doesn't affect finding or understanding.
The index references /img/loaves.jpg but no img folder is in the repo, so the image may be broken.

ideas.idea: Name the heritage grains in the homepage copy
ideas.why: index.html says 'heritage grains' without naming them, so naming them adds specific, quotable content.
